meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 推进计划执行,并行调度多个子代理完成工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你制定好计划后希望一键执行并分派给子代理
copy.tagline_en: Execute your plan and orchestrate parallel subagents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a detailed plan and want to execute it with subagents.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成执行计划的“总指挥”：读取工作计划，把任务拆解并派给多个子代理并行干活，自己只负责调度、验收和进度记录，不直接写代码，直至计划全部完成。
howto.when: 当你说“开始工作”“执行计划”“继续计划”等，或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划时触发。

say.note: 启动 start-work 流程，读取并执行计划。
接着上次未完成的任务继续推进。

say.text: 以 PR 模式执行计划
say.note: 完成后会生成可审查的拉取请求。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: reads the work plan, splits it into small tasks, delegates them to parallel subagents, and only handles scheduling, verification, and progress tracking — never writes code itself — until all plan items are done.
howto.when_en: When you say "start work", "execute plan", "continue plan", etc., or ask to run a .omo/plans plan.

say_en.note: This triggers the start-work flow to read and run the plan.
This resumes unfinished tasks from the last run.

say_en.text: Execute the plan in PR mode
say_en.note: This will produce a reviewable pull request on completion.
